items.title: AAT Architecten about
items.description: A short studio credo: a small portrait photo at the left, then one large paragraph whose first line starts where the photo ends, and an underlined 'more about us' link. items.description: A pinned product tour: a green heading with a hand-drawn underline, a list of four points along a grey rail, two buttons, and a large rounded photo. items.title: Parsley Health theme
items.description: A calm clinic light theme: warm ivory page, deep forest headings, buttons and dark bands, sage links and soft buttons, clover hairlines, mint and seafoam bands, a beige wash and a sparing ochre. A light book serif (Newsreader at 300) for headings over a round geometric sans (Outfit), 12px corners and pill buttons. A forest-green dark sibling.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is the whole site in forest and deep sea

--primary is forest (headings use text-primary), --secondary sage (soft buttons), --ring the same sage (focus rings, and sage text: eyebrows, links, names), --glow clover (hairline dots, column titles), --accent mint, --muted seafoam bands, --card the beige wash, --highlight ochre
the nav bar and footer are .dark scopes, so the dark palette doubles as their on-dark palette in light mode
--section-y is the desktop padding (7.5rem); blocks use 0.55 of it on phones
items.name: parsleyhealth-theme

items.title: Parsley Health trust strip

notes: icons come in as nodes (e.g. lucide icons) and are sized to 40px with a thin stroke

notes: native scroll-snap, no carousel library; the progress bar and arrows need JavaScript (hydrate visible)
tone="band" makes the bar and buttons translucent white, for coloured bands
hide the controls at a breakpoint with controlsClassName (e.g. lg:hidden when every card fits)
items.name: zoe-slider

items.title: Zoe spotlight
items.description: A 24px-rounded product spotlight panel split down the middle: a photo on navy on the left, and on warm cream a chunky, tightly set two-line headline, a short semibold pitch and a navy button. On phones the whole panel turns navy: the headline and a yellow button over the photo (the pitch shows from desktop up).
notes: the phone panel is the foreground colour (card in dark mode); the desktop text half is the accent colour
items.name: zoe-spotlight

items.title: Zoe statement
items.description: A plain, centred mission statement on white: a big semibold heading and one or two short paragraphs in a comfortable 900px measure, with generous 96px breathing room above and below.

items.title: Zoe member stories
items.description: A full-bleed deep-teal band: a small eyebrow and a big white semibold heading over a row of pale-mint quote cards (16px radius), each with a large faint serif quote mark at the top and the quote and name at the bottom. A centred row on desktop; on phones a swipeable slider with a progress bar and translucent round arrows. The quote marks fade in as they enter view.
notes: the band is the highlight colour with highlight-foreground text; cards are the muted colour
four cards fit in one row from 1280px; below that they slide (hydrate visible)

items.title: Zoe theme
items.description: A sunny food-science theme: a white page with deep navy ink, one sunflower-yellow brand colour for buttons and bands, warm cream cards, pale mint quote cards, and two rich bands, deep teal and plum. Figtree throughout with a light bookish serif (Newsreader) and a tall condensed caps face (Antonio) for accents; soft 16–24px radii, flat surfaces. A deep-navy dark sibling.
notes: light is the faithful mode
secondary is the plum footer band and highlight the deep-teal stories band, both with white text in both modes
ring doubles as the violet link colour (links turn it on hover)
sets two theme-only faces for zoe blocks: --zoe-serif (Newsreader) and --zoe-condensed (Antonio)
items.name: zoe-theme

items.title: Zoe wordmark

notes: plain type in the theme's display face, not a logo drawing
